Preconditions: Browser is open; Internet connection available

Description: Verify main navigation menu items presence

Expected Result: Navigation includes: Checking, Savings & CDs, Credit cards, Home loans, Auto, Investing by J.P. Morgan, Education & goals, Travel; All menu items are visible and clickable; Proper spacing and alignment maintained

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage; 2. Locate utility navigation in top right corner; 3. Verify 'Schedule a meeting' link; 4. Verify 'Customer service' dropdown; 5. Verify 'Español' language toggle; 6. Verify 'Search' functionality
Expected Result: All utility links present: Schedule a meeting, Customer service dropdown, Español language toggle, Search functionality; All links are functional and accessible
Notes: Utility navigation provides key customer services

Description: Verify sign-in widget display and elements
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage; 2. Wait 3 seconds for widget to load; 3. Verify 'Welcome' heading; 4. Verify Username textbox is present; 5. Verify Password textbox is present; 6. Verify 'Show Password' button; 7. Verify 'Remember me' checkbox; 8. Verify 'Use token' link; 9. Verify 'Sign in' button; 10. Verify 'Forgot username/password?' link; 11. Verify 'Not Enrolled? Sign Up Now.' link
Expected Result: All widget elements are displayed correctly: Welcome heading, Username field (empty), Password field (empty), Show Password button, Remember me checkbox, Use token link, Sign in button (enabled), Forgot credentials link, Sign Up link
Notes: Widget loads asynchronously - may need wait time

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage and wait for widget; 2. Enter text in password field (e.g., 'TestPassword123'); 3. Click 'Show Password' button; 4. Verify password is visible; 5. Click button again; 6. Verify password is masked
Expected Result: Password is initially masked with dots/asterisks; Clicking 'Show' reveals the actual password text; Button toggles label between 'Show' and 'Hide'; Password can be toggled on/off multiple times; Text remains in field during toggles
Notes: Important for accessibility and user experience

Preconditions: Sign-in widget is visible and functional
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage; 2. Wait for sign-in widget to load; 3. Enter invalid username 'testuser_invalid'; 4. Enter invalid password 'wrongpassword123'; 5. Click 'Sign in' button; 6. Wait for response; 7. Observe error handling and messages
Expected Result: Error message is displayed (may vary due to anti-bot detection); Form remains accessible for retry; Username and password fields are still present and editable; No successful authentication occurs; User is not redirected to dashboard; Error is clearly communicated
Notes: Chase implements anti-bot detection - error messages may vary

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage; 2. Locate 'Remember me' checkbox; 3. Click checkbox to enable; 4. Verify checkbox is checked; 5. Click again to uncheck; 6. Verify checkbox state changes
Expected Result: Checkbox can be toggled on and off; Visual state changes appropriately (checked/unchecked); Checkbox maintains state during form interaction
Notes: Actual remember me functionality requires valid credentials

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to homepage; 2. Locate 'Forgot username/password?' link; 3. Click the link; 4. Verify navigation occurs
Expected Result: Link navigates to password recovery page; Recovery form or options are displayed; URL changes to account recovery endpoint
Notes: Critical for users who cannot access their accounts

Description: Verify credit cards menu dropdown expands

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to creditcards.chase.com; 2. Scroll to 'Our Most Popular Business Cards' section; 3. Verify section heading; 4. Count cards displayed; 5. Verify 'View all Business Cards' link; 6. Verify business-specific benefits; 7. Check compare checkbox labels

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to creditcards.chase.com; 2. Test at desktop (1920x1080); 3. Test at tablet (768x1024); 4. Test at mobile (375x667); 5. Verify card grid adapts; 6. Check carousel behavior; 7. Verify Apply Now buttons remain accessible

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Chase.com; 2. Scroll to footer; 3. Locate privacy policy link; 4. Click privacy policy link; 5. Verify privacy policy page loads; 6. Go back and locate terms of use; 7. Click terms of use link; 8. Verify terms page loads; 9. Test additional legal links

Preconditions: Browser with cleared cache; Good network connection
Test Steps: 1. Clear browser cache; 2. Open browser dev tools and navigate to Network tab; 3. Navigate to Chase.com; 4. Measure page load time; 5. Check for render-blocking resources; 6. Verify First Contentful Paint; 7. Verify Time to Interactive; 8. Check total page size
Expected Result: Page loads in reasonable time (target: < 3 seconds on good connection); First Contentful Paint occurs quickly (target: < 1.5 seconds); Time to Interactive is acceptable (target: < 3.5 seconds); Page size is optimized (no unnecessarily large resources); Critical resources load first; Images are optimized and lazy-loaded where appropriate; No excessive render-blocking JavaScript or CSS
Notes: Performance impacts user experience and SEO

Description: Verify credit cards marketplace load performance
Test Steps: 1. Clear browser cache; 2. Navigate to creditcards.chase.com; 3. Measure page load time; 4. Verify hero carousel loads without blocking; 5. Check product cards lazy loading; 6. Verify images are optimized; 7. Check total page weight
Expected Result: Marketplace page loads efficiently; Hero carousel does not block page rendering; Product card images lazy load as user scrolls; Card images are optimized (WebP or similar formats); Total page size is reasonable given content; Above-the-fold content loads first; Interactive elements become functional quickly
Notes: Fast load time critical for conversion

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to https://www.chase.com/; 2. Check address bar for padlock icon; 3. Click padlock to view certificate; 4. Verify certificate is valid; 5. Check certificate issuer; 6. Verify no mixed content warnings
Expected Result: Page loads over HTTPS; Padlock icon is displayed in address bar; SSL certificate is valid and not expired; Certificate is issued by trusted authority; Certificate is for chase.com domain; No mixed content warnings (all resources load via HTTPS); Connection is secure
Notes: HTTPS is mandatory for financial sites

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to creditcards.chase.com; 2. Click Apply Now on any card; 3. Verify application page URL; 4. Check for HTTPS connection; 5. Verify certificate validity; 6. Check that all resources load securely
Expected Result: Application page URL is secure.chase.com or similar secure subdomain; Connection uses HTTPS; Valid SSL certificate present; No mixed content warnings; All form submissions will occur over HTTPS; Page displays security indicators
Notes: Application data must be transmitted securely

Preconditions: Homepage loaded with sign-in widget visible
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Chase.com; 2. Inspect sign-in form HTML; 3. Verify form submission method is POST; 4. Verify form action URL is HTTPS; 5. Check password field uses type='password'; 6. Verify no credentials visible in URL or network log (without submitting)
Expected Result: Sign-in form uses POST method (not GET); Form action URL is HTTPS; Password field properly uses type='password' for masking; Form includes CSRF token or similar protection; No sensitive data exposed in page source; Password is not visible in browser developer tools when masked
Notes: Sign-in form handles sensitive credentials

Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Chase.com; 2. Press Tab key repeatedly; 3. Verify focus indicator is visible on each element; 4. Verify tab order is logical; 5. Test reverse tabbing with Shift+Tab; 6. Verify all interactive elements are reachable; 7. Test Enter/Space activation on buttons
Expected Result: Focus indicator is clearly visible on all interactive elements; Tab order follows logical reading order; All interactive elements (links, buttons, form fields) are keyboard accessible; Shift+Tab moves focus backwards correctly; Enter key activates links and buttons; Space bar works on buttons and checkboxes; No keyboard traps exist; Skip link may be available
Notes: Keyboard navigation required for accessibility

Preconditions: Homepage loaded with sign-in widget visible
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Chase.com; 2. Tab to sign-in widget; 3. Verify form fields have proper labels; 4. Verify aria-labels where needed; 5. Check error messages are announced; 6. Verify 'Show Password' button has proper label; 7. Test with screen reader if possible
Expected Result: All form fields have associated labels (visible or aria-label); Username and Password fields properly labeled; 'Show Password' button has accessible name; 'Remember me' checkbox has associated label; Error messages (if triggered) are announced to screen readers; Links have descriptive text; Widget is navigable by keyboard alone
Notes: Widget must be accessible to all users

Description: Verify images have alt text on marketplace
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to creditcards.chase.com; 2. Inspect card images; 3. Verify each card image has alt attribute; 4. Check that alt text is meaningful; 5. Verify decorative images use alt=''; 6. Check logo images have appropriate alt text
Expected Result: All credit card images have alt attributes; Alt text meaningfully describes the card (e.g., 'Chase Sapphire Preferred credit card'); Decorative images use empty alt='' appropriately; Logo images have alt text identifying the brand; No images with missing alt attributes; Alt text is concise but descriptive
Notes: Alt text required for screen reader users

Description: Verify color contrast meets WCAG standards
Test Steps: 1. Navigate to Chase.com or creditcards.chase.com; 2. Use color contrast checker tool; 3. Test main text against background; 4. Test button text against button background; 5. Test link colors; 6. Verify minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 for normal text; 7. Verify minimum 3:1 for large text
Expected Result: Main body text has minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio; Large text (18pt+ or 14pt+ bold) has minimum 3:1 ratio; Button text is clearly readable; Link colors have sufficient contrast; Interactive elements maintain contrast in all states (default, hover, focus); Important information is not conveyed by color alone; Text remains readable for users with color blindness
Notes: Adequate contrast required by WCAG 2.1 AA
